headline: Don’t Paste the AI
caption: As developers, it’s tempting to lean on AI for quick fixes and code snippets. But overusing AI without understanding the underlying logic can hurt our problem-solving skills and code quality. It's important to review AI-generated code, test thoroughly, and continue sharpening our own skills. AI is a tool to assist, not replace, our critical thinking. Keep coding, keep learning, and use AI wisely to complement your expertise. Remember, the real value comes from understanding the 'why' behind the code. 💻 #FullStackLife #CodeSmart #DevTips
